epics.title: Knowledge Base Analytics Export
epics.jtbd: When I view the analytics dashboard, I want to export the utilization statistics to a file or EIOS, so that I can use them in educational center reports.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce manual reporting time from hours to seconds
requirements: R1: Generate utilization statistics export including popular queries, views, and downloads.
R2: Support synchronization of the analytics data to EIOS.

slices.title: Implement Analytics Export Endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing the analytics export endpoint for this epic, I want to add file generation and EIOS sync logic to the existing analytics service, so that utilization statistics can be exported or synchronized as required.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an admin user,
When they request an analytics export via the existing analytics endpoint,
Then the backend generates a CSV/PDF report with search queries, views, and downloads, or triggers an EIOS sync.

epics.title: System Backup Administration
epics.jtbd: When I perform administrative duties, I want to trigger a system backup, so that I can ensure data safety and recover from failures.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase data recovery capability confidence to 100%
requirements: R1: Expose a backup trigger capability for administrators.
R2: Securely capture and store a snapshot of the database and uploaded files.

slices.title: Implement System Backup Trigger
slices.jtbd: When implementing the backup trigger for this epic, I want to add snapshot and file archiving logic to the existing admin service, so that data safety and recovery capabilities are guaranteed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated admin user,
When they trigger a system backup request,
Then the backend successfully creates and securely stores a combined snapshot of the database and uploaded files.

epics.title: Unified Search with LMS Metadata
epics.jtbd: When I search the knowledge base, I want the results to include indexed materials from LMS platforms (SDO/Teachbase), so that I can find all relevant educational content.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: increase overall search retrieval completeness by 30%
requirements: R1: Include LMS metadata from platforms like SDO and Teachbase in the search index.
R2: Merge local Knowledge Base documents and LMS metadata into a unified search response.

slices.title: Integrate LMS Metadata into Search
slices.jtbd: When implementing unified search for this epic, I want to patch the existing search logic to include synchronized LmsMetadata, so that all relevant educational content is returned in a single query.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user providing a search query,
When the search is executed,
Then the backend queries both local KbDocuments and synchronized LmsMetadata, returning a unified set of results.
